---
title: "Life Expectancy and Population"
---

This page analyzes how life expectancy relates to population (in millions) over time.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

fig = px.scatter(
    df,
    x="population_millions",
    y="life_expectancy",
    color="continent",
    hover_name="country",
    animation_frame="year",
    log_x=True,
    labels={
        "population_millions": "Population (millions, log scale)",
        "life_expectancy": "Life Expectancy"
    },
    title="Life Expectancy vs Population Over Time"
)
fig.show()
